info.title: v2.order.get_estimate_cancel_value
info.description: Returns the estimated refund value for a partial order cancellation given the specified items to cancel.

post.description: Returns the estimated refund value for a partial order cancellation given the specified items to cancel.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the item to be included in the estimated cancellation value calculation.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the model to be included in the estimated cancellation value calculation.

parameters.name: model_quantity
parameters.description: The quantity of the specified item model to be included in the estimated cancellation value calculation.

parameters.name: order_item_id
parameters.description: The identify of order item. For items in one same bundle deal promotion, the order_item_id should share the same id, such as 1,2. For items not in bundle deal promotion, the order_item_id should be the same as item_id.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: partial_cancel_item_list
parameters.description: The list of item models and quantities for which the seller wants to estimate the cancellation value before submitting the actual partial cancellation request.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: promotion_group_id
parameters.description: The identify of product promotion.It's required for add on deal and bundle deal items. For items in one same add on deal or bundle deal promotion, the promotion_group_id should share the same id. For items not in add on deal or bundle deal promotion, the promotion_group_id should be 0. And the data is from promotion_group_id of v2,order.get_order_detail.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/get_estimate_cancel_value?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "order_sn": "2012300NQJVTYN",
    "partial_cancel_item_list": [
        {
            "item_id": 1680783,
            "model_id": 327890123,
            "model_quantity": 2,
            "order_item_id": 0,
            "promotion_group_id": 0
        }
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: cancel_value_price
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The estimated cancellation value for the selected item quantities. This value is calculated before the actual cancellation is submitted and can be used by sellers to preview the expected cancellation amount and support partial cancellation confirmation.
